to: AGENTS.md is a 294-line copy of CLAUDE.md, and the two already disagree

AGENTS.md is the single source for repository instructions, and .agents/skills is the single source for all skills. Claude reads AGENTS.md through a minimal CLAUDE.md import and discovers the same skill directories through relative symlinks in .claude/skills. Host-specific hook configuration remains separate because the schemas and environment differ.
